chapters.title: Chapter 2731: Ninth Heaven
paragraphs: When Yuan arrived at the Nameless Stairway, he was greeted by a familiar scene.
Several people, who were clearly blacksmiths, were gathered around the treasure, inspecting it.
However, unlike before, they didn’t block the entrance, merely inspecting the treasure from the sides.
Ever since Yuan’s incident with the Indestructible Steel Association, the entire organization had been plagued by difficulties no one could have imagined.

Because Yuan had barred every member of the association from using the Nameless Stairway, their blacksmiths had only two options if they wanted to travel through the Nine Heavens. Either leave the association or journey through the starry sky.

Due to the nature of their profession, traveling throughout the Nine Heavens was both common and often necessary. However, this restriction confined the blacksmiths to their own realm, severely limiting their opportunities.

With no other choice, the Indestructible Steel Association was forced to make special exceptions for its blacksmiths, allowing them to temporarily leave the association whenever they needed to travel throughout the Nine Heavens.
However, they had to rejoin within a certain period of time. Otherwise, they would be permanently removed and forced to go through the entire joining process again from the beginning.
Although the arrangement was tedious and inconvenient, it was the only way the association could keep its numbers from dwindling too much and remain in control.
Of course, they had sought help from the Celestial Emperor, but he seemed far more interested in Yuan’s name than in their predicament.
In response to the blacksmiths’ complaints, the Celestial Emperor revealed that he still intended to install the replacement he had originally planned during the Stairway to Heaven’s disappearance.

After all, even though the Stairway to Heaven had already been replaced by the Nameless Stairway, the Celestial Emperor had no control over it. Moreover, he had long wanted to replace the Stairway to Heaven with one under his own authority but had never been given the opportunity, so he wasn’t about to abandon his plans so easily.

The Indestructible Steel Association was ecstatic upon hearing the news. However, since the replacement was still under development, they had no choice but to endure their current predicament for a little longer.
Shortly after their arrival, Yuan and Mu Xuelian approached the Nameless Stairway. However, when they got close, someone approached them and asked, "Are you going to use the stairway?"
"Why are you asking?" Yuan questioned with a suspicious look.
"The Celestial Emperor has mandated that everyone using the stairway must be logged, so if you plan on using it, we’ll need to verify your identity."
Yuan raised an eyebrow and continued asking, "Since when did this become a thing?"
"Yesterday."
"And what if we refuse?"
"Well... we’d have to report you to Heaven’s Mandate."
"And how are you going to do that without knowing my identity?" Yuan said with a smile.
"Do you really want to find out the hard way?" The man calmly shook his head, having encountered plenty of people like Yuan in a single day.
"I don’t suggest it," another voice suddenly said.
Yuan turned to look at the man who’d just spoken.
"This isn’t a simple rule, but a Heavenly Law," the man explained.
Heavenly Laws are rules every living being in the Nine Heavens must obey, and disobeying them would trigger Heavenly Judgment.
’The Celestial Emperor made it into a Heavenly Law? He must be looking for someone... and quite desperate, too,’ Yuan smiled inwardly.
He looked at the man who’d asked for his identity and asked, "How do you want me to confirm my identity?"
The man retrieved a scroll and said, "A drop of your blood."
The next moment, Yuan produced a single drop of blood and fed it to the scroll without the slightest hesitation.
Although doing so could potentially expose his presence to the Celestial Emperor, Yuan wasn’t worried in the slightest. In fact, he no longer had any intention of hiding from him.
’If he comes after me, then so be it...’ Yuan smiled inwardly, almost hoping that would happen.
The scroll consumed Yuan’s blood, and soon, information appeared on it.
The man raised an eyebrow after seeing the information.
"You’re a Player?" he said aloud.
"Does that change anything?" Yuan asked, surprised it even identified him as a Player, since he’d been kicked off the system long ago.
"A little," the man said, not bothering to elaborate.
He then handed Yuan a small jade token and said, "Make sure you’re carrying this when you use the stairway."
Yuan accepted the token and waited for Mu Xuelian to verify her identity.
Once Mu Xuelian provided her blood, the man waited for the scroll to show her information.
"Huh. How strange. Nothing is showing up for you," he said a moment later when the scroll remained blank.
Sorry, but unless you can provide another means of verifying your identity, I can’t allow you to use the stairway."
Mu Xuelian didn’t even bother to argue with the man and turned to Yuan.
"Gates of Heaven, right? I’ll meet you there," she said.
"Don’t tell me you’re going to traverse through the starry sky."
Mu Xuelian calmly nodded at Yuan’s question.
Then, without another word, Mu Xuelian flew away.
Yuan watched her swiftly vanish into the sky, not bothering to stop her.
Some time later, Yuan entered the Nameless Stairway.
The interior of the Nameless Stairway was the exact same as the Stairway to Heaven.
"Take me to the Ninth Heaven," he commanded the treasure.
The next moment, a set of semi-transparent stairs materialized before Yuan, stretching upward into the distance.
Yuan calmly climbed the stairs.
One step... ten steps... a hundred steps...
Two hundred steps later, a single door stood at the end of the stairs.
Yuan opened the door and stepped inside, vanishing into the void.
<You have arrived at the Ninth Heaven>
"At last, I’ve reached the Ninth Heaven..." Yuan muttered, memories of when he first began his journey in the Lower Heavens flashing through his mind.
After so many years, he had finally ascended from the Lower Heavens to the Supreme Heaven.

chapters.title: Chapter 2732: Ninth Heaven(2)
paragraphs: The spiritual energy filling the Ninth Heaven was incredibly dense and rich, incomparably superior to that of the Eighth Heaven.

There was a reason nearly every cultivator in the lower realms dreamed of ascending higher and eventually reaching the Ninth Heaven. With such an abundance of spiritual energy, reaching the God Ascension realm would be incomparably easier.
Of course, whether one could truly reach the God Ascension realm still depended heavily on their individual talent, as an abundance of spiritual energy alone could never guarantee success.
Shortly after Yuan arrived at the Ninth Heaven, a notification popped up before him, raising his eyebrows.
<Congratulations! You have reached the Supreme Heaven and fulfilled the first requirement of Supreme Heaven’s Legacy!>
<You have acquired a Unique Quest!>
[Unique Quest: Island of Liberty]
[Description: Bring the exile ’Xiao Hua’ to the Island of Liberty and pass the trial presented to you.]
[Reward: The exile ’Xiao Hua’ and those of the same bloodline may leave the Primordial Realm and will no longer be considered exiles.]
Yuan couldn’t help but chuckle after seeing the new quest.
Although Xiao Hua and her family had already been freed from the Primordial Realm, they were still branded as exiles, and that status would remain until Yuan completed the legacy.
However, Yuan had no intention of fulfilling it. Once he dealt with the Celestial Emperor—something he knew would eventually happen—they would be free regardless.
Ding!
Suddenly, another notification appeared.
<Due to Supreme Heaven’s Legacy, Xiao Hua’s Mark of Banishment has strengthened>

’Mark of Banishment... This must be the curse that identifies someone as an exile. If it’s grown stronger, does that mean she’ll have a much harder time concealing her status as one?’ Yuan wondered inwardly.
While one might have expected Yuan to be concerned for Xiao Hua, he actually felt pity for anyone bold enough to hunt her down, especially now that she’s regained her memory and power.
Some time later, Yuan stopped lingering and went to the nearest city.
"Is there a Myriad of Techniques in this city?" Yuan asked the guards stationed at the city entrance.
"No, but there is one in the city that is just south of here."
"Thanks."
Yuan immediately went to that city and entered the Myriad of Techniques there.
However, he didn’t go there so he could speak with Senior Bai. Rather, he just wanted directions to the Gates of Heaven.
"Where is the Gates of Heaven located?" Yuan asked the man behind the counter.

"Gates of Heaven? You can just teleport there from any major teleportation device," said the man. "If you want to go there on your own... that would be a little difficult, as the sect exists outside the Ninth Heaven."
"I see... thanks."
Shortly after, Yuan left the store and headed to the teleportation device.
Fortunately for him, one was in the same city, so he didn’t have to travel far.
However, as the teleportation device came into view, a figure descended from the sky and landed right in front of him.
Yuan raised an eyebrow after seeing this individual.
"Xiao?" The individual, a beautiful young lady, muttered, staring directly at Yuan’s face.
Yuan wasn’t sure how to respond.
The individual before him was none other than Qiang Qing Yun, one of the four Celestial Overlords and the one who’d recruited Yuan to join their faction after Xu Jiaqi removed him.

"There’s no point pretending you don’t know me, Xiao. As a Celestial Overlord, I have the authority to see the location of every member of the faction as long as they’re within the Nine Heavens," Qiang Qing Yun continued a moment later, before Yuan could respond.
"I wasn’t going to pretend to not know you," Yuan replied. "I was just surprised by your sudden appearance and wondering why you appeared before me in such a fashion."
"I’ll tell you in a bit. Follow me," she said, turning around and walking away, not giving him the chance to refuse.
Yuan said nothing and quietly followed her.
Qiang Qing Yun led Yuan to an empty alley, then opened a portal.
"Come," she said, then disappeared into the portal.
After following her through the portal, Yuan found himself in a familiar place.
He had been brought to the Celestial Overlords’ Headquarters, a place he had visited once before when Xu Jiaqi took him there.
Although the location was different from the last time he had visited, the atmosphere felt exactly the same.
Some time later, Qiang Qing Yun led Yuan into a building—her private office.
Once inside, she turned around and faced him with a serious expression.
"I’ll get straight to the point. You were the one who clashed with the Second Squad of Heaven’s Mandate—the one responsible for our karma suddenly plummeting, correct?"
’So this is what it’s about...’ Yuan sighed inwardly, realizing his situation.
"How did you come to that conclusion?" Yuan asked.

Qiang Qing Yun rubbed her eyes and sighed before replying, "We have something called the Karma Obelisk, which allows us to track everyone’s karma. Although not everyone has been verified yet... you’re the most suspicious of them."
"I see..." Yuan mumbled.
"Why did you do it?" Qiang Qing Yun asked, a frown slowly forming on her face.
"Who are you, really?"
"Would you believe me if I said it was self-defense?" Yuan said.
"No," she answered immediately.

"You know, there’s a certain rumor going around—that someone forcibly opened the Primordial Realm and allowed several extremely dangerous exiles to escape, and that the Second Squad of Heaven’s Mandate was deployed for that reason."

Although the Celestial Emperor tried to keep the opening of the Primordial Realm and the Asura Clan’s escape a secret to prevent widespread panic, it was inevitable that some of the information would eventually leak out.
Suddenly, Qiang Qing Yun raised her arm, and a sword materialized in her grasp out of thin air before she pointed it directly at Yuan.
"Give me one reason why I shouldn’t cut you down right here and now," she said coldly, her aura steadily rising.

chapters.title: Chapter 2733: Jade Serenity
paragraphs: "A reason not to kill me, huh?" Yuan repeated, his face remaining calm and nonchalant despite her threat.
"I’ll do better than that. I’ll give you two. The first reason is... you won’t be able to kill me even if you tried—"
Before Yuan could finish his sentence, Qiang Qing Yun swung her sword at him, the blade stopping just before his neck.
"I won’t be able to kill you, who is only at the third level of God Ascension?" Qiang Qing Yun muttered coldly, revealing some of her aura as a ninth-level God Ascension cultivator.
"That’s not funny, even as a joke."
Yuan glanced at the sword without moving his head and smiled, "A fine sword you have there."
He placed a single finger right on the sharp end of the blade and casually pushed it away from his neck.
’What tremendous strength!’ Qiang Qing Yun cried inwardly when she couldn’t resist Yuan’s strength.
Although she wasn’t using all her strength, Qiang Qing Yun was shocked to be pushed back by someone with far inferior cultivation.
"As for my second reason—"
"I don’t want to hear it," Qiang Qing Yun interrupted, her aura skyrocketing.
In a split second, Qiang Qing Yun overpowered Yuan, pressing her blade to his neck once again.
Still with his finger on the blade, Yuan smiled and said, "Are you sure you don’t want to hear it?"
Without hesitation, Qiang Qing Yun poured more strength into her arm, seemingly intent on severing Yuan’s head.

"Quite frankly, I don’t care about your reasoning at all. It won’t change the fact that you’d attacked Heaven’s Mandate and offended the Celestial Emperor. As the one who recruited you into the faction, I must bear responsibility," she said, slowly pushing the blade into Yuan’s neck.
"Resistance is futile, but if you don’t make this more difficult than it has to be, I’ll promise to make it as painless as possible."
"Sure."
To her surprise, Yuan actually removed his finger from the blade, allowing it full access to his neck.
Then, he placed his hands behind his back and closed his eyes.
Seeing this, Qiang Qing Yun moved swiftly. She pulled her sword away from his neck, enveloped it in Sword Aura, and swung it at his neck again, killing intent flashing in her eyes.
However, just as the sword reached Yuan’s neck, it abruptly came to a halt.
Qiang Qing Yun’s eyes widened in bewilderment.
One might have assumed that she had willingly stopped herself just before taking Yuan’s head, but that wasn’t the case.
Rather, the sword had stopped on its own, trembling violently as it resisted Qiang Qing Yun’s command.
’W-What is going on?!’ she cried inwardly, staring at her beloved sword in puzzlement.
"Confused?"
Qiang Qing Yun shifted her gaze to Yuan, who was looking at her with a smile on his face.
"What did you do to my sword?" she asked with a deep frown.
"You mean the Jade Serenity? I didn’t do anything to it."
Qiang Qing Yun’s eyes widened like saucers when Yuan uttered the name of her sword, something only she knew.
"H-How do you know the name of my sword?! It has never been revealed to the public before!" she exclaimed.

The sword in her grasp had been passed down to her directly from its original owner, who said they’d personally crafted it for her. In other words, besides its creator and her, nobody else should know its name.
"The same way I know that your name used to be Mao Qing Yun," Yuan responded.
The moment Qiang Qing Yun heard those words, her entire body froze, and the sword slipped from her grasp, falling toward the ground.
However, Yuan caught it before it hit the floor.
"W-Who are you?" Qiang Qing Yun muttered as she slowly backed away from Yuan, a nervous expression spreading across her face.
"Do I really have to spell it out for you?"
Qiang Qing Yun stared intently at Yuan’s face, and a certain face from her memories—one that had grown blurry over time—gradually sharpened.
"S-Senior Tian?" she muttered, looking dazed.
"Y-You were alive this entire time?"
Yuan shook his head and revealed, "No, the man you knew died long ago, and I am his reincarnation."
"Reincarnation...?" Qiang Qng Yun mumbled.
Yuan handed the sword back to her and said, "I only recently regained my memories of our relationship."
The Level 6 treatment he had undergone in Gaia’s Heaven hadn’t just erased some of his earlier memories—it had also helped him recover some from his other incarnations.
Qiang Qing Yun subconsciously accepted the sword before asking, "Wh-Why did you clash with Heaven’s Mandate? What about breaking out criminals from the Primordial Realm? Are the rumors true?"
"What happened to not caring about my reasoning?" Yuan remarked with a chuckle.
"That’s..." Qiang Qing Yun fell silent.
After a moment of silence, Yuan spoke with a serious face, "It’s true. I clashed with Heaven’s Mandate, and I even freed some exiles from the Primordial Realm. As for the reason..."
Yuan paused for a second, then shook his head and apologized, "Sorry, but if I tell you, I’d get you involved in my trouble."
"I-I don’t care!" Qiang Qing Yun quickly responded. "If you’re in trouble, I’ll help you!"
"It’s too dangerous."
"No matter how dangerous it is, I can handle it! I am no longer the powerless young girl I was before! I can help you!" she exclaimed in a heartfelt voice.
"If you really want to help, you can start by helping Xu Jiaqi regain control of the faction," Yuan said.
"Xu Jiaqi...?" Qiang Qing Yun mumbled.
"So it’s true? That she’s your daughter?" she then asked.

Despite Xu Jiaqi’s insistent claim that she was Tian Yingzhe’s adoptive daughter, the others took her words with a grain of salt. They never fully believed her, suspecting that she was merely using such a claim to gain support from others.
"We’re not blood-related, but it’s true that our relationship was something similar to that," Yuan confirmed.
Hearing this, Qiang Qing Yun fell silent, a pondering expression on her face.

However, just as the sword reached Yuan’s neck, it abruptly came to a halt.
Qiang Qing Yun’s eyes widened in bewilderment.
One might have assumed that she had willingly stopped herself just before taking Yuan’s head, but that wasn’t the case.
Rather, the sword had stopped on its own, trembling violently as it resisted Qiang Qing Yun’s command.
’W-What is going on?!’ she cried inwardly, staring at her beloved sword in puzzlement.
"Confused?"
Qiang Qing Yun shifted her gaze to Yuan, who was looking at her with a smile on his face.
"What did you do to my sword?" she asked with a deep frown.
"You mean the Jade Serenity?
I didn’t do anything to it."
Qiang Qing Yun’s eyes widened like saucers when Yuan uttered the name of her sword, something only she knew.
"H-How do you know the name of my sword?!
It has never been revealed to the public before!" she exclaimed.
The sword in her grasp had been passed down to her directly from its original owner, who said they’d personally crafted it for her.
In other words, besides its creator and her, nobody else should know its name.
"The same way I know that your name used to be Mao Qing Yun," Yuan responded.
The moment Qiang Qing Yun heard those words, her entire body froze, and the sword slipped from her grasp, falling toward the ground.
However, Yuan caught it before it hit the floor.
"W-Who are you?" Qiang Qing Yun muttered as she slowly backed away from Yuan, a nervous expression spreading across her face.
"Do I really have to spell it out for you?"
Qiang Qing Yun stared intently at Yuan’s face, and a certain face from her memories—one that had grown blurry over time—gradually sharpened.
"S-Senior Tian?" she muttered, looking dazed.
"Y-You were alive this entire time?"
Yuan shook his head and revealed, "No, the man you knew died long ago, and I am his reincarnation."
"Reincarnation...?" Qiang Qng Yun mumbled.
Yuan handed the sword back to her and said, "I only recently regained my memories of our relationship."
The Level 6 treatment he had undergone in Gaia’s Heaven hadn’t just erased some of his earlier memories—it had also helped him recover some from his other incarnations.
Qiang Qing Yun subconsciously accepted the sword before asking, "Wh-Why did you clash with Heaven’s Mandate?
What about breaking out criminals from the Primordial Realm?
Are the rumors true?"
"What happened to not caring about my reasoning?" Yuan remarked with a chuckle.
"That’s..." Qiang Qing Yun fell silent.
After a moment of silence, Yuan spoke with a serious face, "It’s true.
I clashed with Heaven’s Mandate, and I even freed some exiles from the Primordial Realm.
As for the reason..."
Yuan paused for a second, then shook his head and apologized, "Sorry, but if I tell you, I’d get you involved in my trouble."
"I-I don’t care!" Qiang Qing Yun quickly responded.
"If you’re in trouble, I’ll help you!"
"It’s too dangerous."
"No matter how dangerous it is, I can handle it!
I am no longer the powerless young girl I was before!
I can help you!" she exclaimed in a heartfelt voice.
"If you really want to help, you can start by helping Xu Jiaqi regain control of the faction," Yuan said.
"Xu Jiaqi...?" Qiang Qing Yun mumbled.
"So it’s true?
That she’s your daughter?" she then asked.
Despite Xu Jiaqi’s insistent claim that she was Tian Yingzhe’s adoptive daughter, the others took her words with a grain of salt.
They never fully believed her, suspecting that she was merely using such a claim to gain support from others.
"We’re not blood-related, but it’s true that our relationship was something similar to that," Yuan confirmed.
Hearing this, Qiang Qing Yun fell silent, a pondering expression on her face.

chapters.title: Chapter 2734: Karma Obelisk
paragraphs: "If you want me to support Xu Jiaqi, then that’s what I’ll do," Qiang Qing Yun said after a moment of silence. "I still owe you for saving my life, after all."

Although she had intended to become the next leader of the Celestial Overlords, it wasn’t out of ambition. Rather, she simply wanted to protect something that had once belonged to someone precious to her because she thought the others were trying to ruin it.
However, now that the founder of the faction had returned, Qiang Qing Yun no longer had any reason to fight for the top position.
"What do you know about the other two Celestial Overlords?" Yuan asked a moment later.
"Liu Yucang and Bi Ao? What do you want to know about them?"
"Everything you know."

"Then not much. Bi Ao was already part of the faction before I joined, and he’s extremely secretive. However, he currently has the most support within the faction, with roughly forty percent of its members on his side."

"As for Liu Yucang, he has a rough and arrogant personality. In terms of influence, he’s the weakest in the faction. However, he’s been aggressively trying to increase his influence recently by forming alliances with other factions."
"Do you know why they’re trying to take control of the faction?" Yuan then asked.
Qiang Qing Yun shook her head.

"Although I don’t know their motives, I doubt it’s anything good. Even though the faction is in a mess internally, it’s still one of the most powerful factions in the Nine Heavens, and being its leader will obviously have plenty of perks."
After a brief pause, Qiang Qing Yun asked, "Are you going to deal with them?"

Yuan raised an eyebrow and replied, "No, not unless they do something that warrants it. I may have founded the Celestial Overlords, but my era passed long ago. At this point, I consider myself nothing more than an observer."
"So you have no intention of returning to the Celestial Overlords...?" Qiang Qing Yun mumbled dispiritedly, having expected him to reclaim his position as their leader.
Yuan quietly shook his head.
After a moment of silence, Qiang Qing Yun asked, "If you’re going to abandon it so easily, why did you create the Celestial Overlords in the first place?"
Yuan didn’t immediately respond, and a pondering expression appeared on his face.
"Quite frankly, I don’t remember."
"Huh?" Qiang Qing Yun’s eyes widened as she stared at him in disbelief.
"I still have some memories that have yet to return," he explained.
"I-Is that so..."
"Anyways, before I leave, I’d like to use the Karma Obelisk," Yuan said a moment later.
"Why?" Qiang Qing Yun questioned, her eyebrows raised in puzzlement.
"I’m curious about something."
"Alright..."
Qiang Qing Yun led Yuan to the Karma Obelisk, which stood in the middle of a large, open plaza.
The obelisk was roughly twenty meters tall and appeared to be carved entirely from white jade.
There were names engraved on the obelisk, with Qiang Qing Yun and the other Celestial Overlords’ names at the top.
"Xu Jiaqi is first, huh?" Yuan muttered after seeing her name sitting above everyone else.
"Although she has a cold personality and often comes across as distant, no one in the faction can deny how much effort she puts into it," Qiang Qing Yun said.
She turned to face Yuan and continued, "So, what are you curious about?"
Without responding, Yuan approached the Karma Obelisk and placed a hand on it.
The obelisk immediately began glowing, and soon, a number appeared at the very top.
"?!?!" Qiang Qing Yun’s eyes widened in disbelief.
"That’s impossible!" she cried out after rubbing her eyes and confirming that she was seeing things clearly.
The next moment, the names engraved on the obelisk began to shift, each one moving down a position. Then, at the very top—even above Xu Jiaqi’s name—Yuan’s name appeared.
"What is going on?! Did you do something to the obelisk?!" She turned to ask Yuan.
"No, I didn’t do anything to it. The Karma Obelisk isn’t something that can be manipulated, either."
"Then how...?"
A look of realization suddenly flashed across Qiang Qing Yun’s face, and she said, "Don’t tell me that you were lying about being responsible for our karma dropping?!"
She believed that Yuan had lied about being the perpetrator, as that was the only logical explanation.
"No, that really was me. I clashed with Heaven’s Mandate and killed many of their soldiers. I suppose what I did afterward earned me enough karma to recover everything I lost and then some."
"What did you do...? And when? As far as I’m aware, our faction’s ranking hasn’t changed. However, if you truly recovered all the karma we lost, we would’ve noticed immediately—"
Qiang Qing Yun suddenly stopped mid-sentence when she felt her communication jade slip tremble.
She instinctively reached for it and listened to the message she had just received.
"Celestial Overlord Qiang! You won’t believe this, but not only has our faction regained our old ranking, but it’s even risen by four ranks! We’re ranked third in the Karma Ranking now!"
Qiang Qing Yun fell silent after hearing the message, her eyes shifting back to the Karma Obelisk.
"H-How?" Qiang Qing Yun asked Yuan again a moment later.
However, Yuan remained silent with a mysterious smile on his face.
’Looks like killing all those demons had an effect on my karma,’ Yuan thought inwardly.

Just like killing exiles and criminals, killing demons also granted karma. In fact, demons were among the most rewarding targets for gaining karma due to how difficult they were to kill, and during the Divine Paragon’s banquet, Yuan had slain thousands of them.

As for why the rankings hadn’t updated until Yuan touched the Karma Obelisk, it was likely because he had accumulated so much karma at once that the system needed additional time to calculate and register it.

"If you don’t want to tell me, don’t," Qiang Qing Yun began speaking again a moment later. "However, I must warn you that this won’t fix your situation, as it won’t revert what you’ve done to Heaven’s Mandate, and you’re still being hunted by them."

chapters.title: Chapter 2735: Celestial Overlords’ Gathering
paragraphs: "I am aware that this won’t magically fix everything," Yuan said calmly. "I didn’t do this for such a reason, either."
"Then why...?" Qiang Qing Yun asked, sounding utterly puzzled.
However, before Yuan could respond, several powerful presences suddenly appeared and enveloped the entire area.
Moments later, numerous figures arrived before them. Among the many powerful presences, three stood out in particular—a handsome green-haired man, an elderly man, and, of course, Xu Jiaqi.
All four Celestial Overlords had suddenly gathered in one place.
’Yuan?! What’s he doing here?!’ Xu Jiaqi cried inwardly after seeing Yuan.
Meanwhile, Liu Yucang and Bi Ao glanced at Yuan for a split second, then turned their attention to Qiang Qing Yun and the Karma Obelisk.
"Xiao? Who the hell is that? And how did they suddenly climb to the top of the ranking?" Liu Yucang questioned aloud.
Since Yuan joined the Celestial Overlords under the alias ’Xiao’, that’s what appeared on the obelisk.
Qiang Qing Yun didn’t respond and looked at Yuan with a perplexed expression, unsure how to answer.
Seeing this, Yuan stepped forward and revealed, "I’m Xiao."
Liu Yucang and Bi Ao shifted their attention back to Yuan, their eyebrows raised in confusion.
"So you’re responsible for our faction’s sudden karma increase? How did you do it? And who are you?" Bi Ao inquired.
"I was recently recruited by Celestial Overlord Qiang," Yuan said. "As for how I increased the karma... sorry, but I won’t be sharing it."

"There’s no way a new recruit who’s only at the third level of God Ascension could’ve gained this much karma so quickly legitimately!" Liu Yucang shouted loudly. "He must’ve messed with the Karma Obelisk in some way!"

Xu Jiaqi then spoke, "The fact that our faction has risen to third place in the Karma Ranking means that the karma he earned was verified by the system itself. That isn’t something that can be achieved simply by manipulating the Karma Obelisk."
"I don’t know how he did it, but there’s no way it’s legit! The amount of karma he’d acquired in such a short time is simply impossible!" Liu Yucang exclaimed, refusing to believe it.
"Legit or not, I don’t care..." Bi Ao said suddenly, taking a step toward Yuan. "I only want to know if you can keep doing it."
Yuan smiled at the old man before replying, "No."

"Are you guys insane?! Do you have any idea what would happen—if it hasn’t already happened—to our reputation once the news spread?! There’s no way the other factions would sit still while we acquired so much questionable karma!" Liu Yucang said.

Although Qiang Qing Yun and Xu Jiaqi didn’t believe Yuan had manipulated the karma system, they agreed with Liu Yucang that acquiring so much karma in the blink of an eye would definitely raise questions.
Moreover, Yuan’s refusal to explain how he acquired the karma would make things even more difficult for them.

Qiang Qing Yun looked at Yuan and asked, "Are you really unwilling to reveal how you acquired the karma? The other factions will be asking questions, and if we can’t provide an answer... things might get ugly, you know?"
Yuan quietly nodded.

If he revealed that he had earned the karma by killing demons, they would inevitably realize that he and the Divine Paragon were one and the same and, more importantly, that the Divine Paragon was still alive.
"Alright," Qiang Qing Yun said without the slightest change in her expression.
Her calm response left not only Bi Ao and Liu Yucang speechless, but even Xu Jiaqi was dumbfounded by how casually she was behaving.

While Qiang Qing Yun was by no means a strict individual like Xu Jiaqi, she wasn’t a pushover either. As a Celestial Overlord, it made little sense for her to let Yuan keep such an important secret, especially when the faction would face trouble because of it.
Xu Jiaqi looked between Qiang Qing Yun and Yuan, her eyes darting back and forth as she tried to figure out what kind of relationship they had.
"Y-You can’t be serious!" Liu Yucang exclaimed in disbelief, trembling with anger.
"Fine! If you won’t do your job, I’ll do it for you!"
Liu Yucang started walking toward Yuan, his ninth-level God Ascension cultivation surging violently around him.
"You dare lay a hand on my recruit in front of me?" Qiang Qing Yun narrowed her eyes as her own aura erupted with equal intensity.
Their auras collided, causing the entire world to tremble.

"This isn’t just about you or your recruit! This is a matter that could cause irreversible damage to the faction! Even before the incident with Heaven’s Mandate, the other factions were already waiting for our downfall!" Liu Yucang shouted angrily. "Now that we’ve suffered two major incidents back-to-back, there’s no doubt they’ll try to destroy us while they still have the chance!"
Qiang Qing Yun sneered disdainfully. "If I didn’t know any better, I might actually believe you cared about the faction’s well-being after hearing such heartfelt words."
"You damn alcoholic bitch! What the hell do you know about me and my passion?!" Liu Yucang roared, veins bulging all over his face.
"What did you just call me, you ugly broccoli head?!" Qiang Qing Yun gritted her teeth in anger.
"B-Broccoli head?! I’ll fucking kill you!"
Seeing how things were quickly getting out of hand, Xu Jiaqi stepped between them and said coldly, "Are you two trying to destroy the headquarters?"
Qiang Qing Yun and Liu Yucang’s aura began to calm down after hearing Xu Jiaqi’s words.

Although it was common for the Celestial Overlords to bicker among themselves, their disputes had never escalated to the point of actual violence. Had Xu Jiaqi not stepped in, however, that would have undoubtedly changed.
As the atmosphere calmed down, Yuan suddenly remembered something and muttered, "Hm? Liu Yucang?"
Liu Yucang’s gaze snapped toward Yuan, his eyes filled with killing intent.
"Who gave you permission to utter my name?"
A smile tugged at Yuan’s lips as he responded, "Then should I call you bush head instead?"
"W-What?" Liu Yucang’s eyes widened in disbelief at the nickname, his mouth falling open in shock.

chapters.title: Chapter 2736: Liu Yucang
paragraphs: "What? You don’t like that one either? Then how about Moss Head? Moldy Bun Head?" Yuan kept throwing one ridiculous nickname after another at Liu Yucang, leaving not only him stunned, but Xu Jiaqi and the others too.
Even Qiang Qing Yun only dared to call him Broccoli Head once in a while because she knew just how badly Liu Yucang handled his temper.
Xu Jiaqi and Qiang Qing Yun immediately prepared to fight Liu Yucang to protect Yuan.
However, Liu Yucang stood as still as a stone statue, his head lowered and his face hidden beneath his long, green hair.
Liu Yucang had been ready to explode with anger when Yuan first called him Bush Head. Yet the more Yuan mocked him, the calmer he became.
’Calling me Bush Head and Moss Head is one thing... but Moldy Bun Head? That’s too specific!’ Liu Yucang cried inwardly as his childhood memories resurfaced.
Yuan continued speaking a moment later, but he was no longer mocking Liu Yucang with nicknames.
"Jade Tiger Mountain Valley," Yuan said, naming a location that instantly sent jolts through Liu Yucang’s entire being.
Liu Yucang slowly lifted his head to stare at Yuan with trembling eyes.
"If I remember correctly, there were seven of you at that time," said Yuan.
"Y-You... You can’t be..." Liu Yucang muttered in a daze.
Yuan replied with a smile, "I’ll explain it to you in a moment. For now, just calm down."
After a moment of silence, Liu Yucang nodded quietly, then completely retracted his aura.
This left everyone speechless, as no one had ever seen Liu Yucang act so obediently before.
’What the hell is going on?’ Bi Ao cried inwardly, unable to comprehend the situation.
Meanwhile, Xu Jiaqi and Qiang Qing Yun had an idea of why Liu Yucang suddenly calmed down.
Shortly after, Yuan turned to Bi Ao and asked, "Do you have anything else to say?"
"No, not really... There’s nothing I can really do at this point but wait for the outcome," Bi Ao responded with a casual shrug before turning around and vanishing into thin air.
Those who’d followed him to the headquarters also left.
Eventually, only Yuan and the other three Celestial Overlords—and their followers—remained.
"Let’s go somewhere more private, shall we?" Yuan said.
Some time later, they entered a private chamber used only by the Celestial Overlords.
Once the doors closed, Yuan turned to Liu Yucang and said, "First and foremost, let me catch you up to speed."
"Yes, I am who you think I am—but also not at the same time."
"What is that supposed to mean?" Liu Yucang asked, raising an eyebrow.
"The man who found you in Jade Tiger Mountain Valley when you were a dirty bandit is dead, and I am his reincarnation," Yuan gave a brief explanation.
Liu Yucang’s jaw dropped.
"His... reincarnation?"
"It’s true," Qiang Qing Yun confirmed.
Liu Yucang looked at her with raised eyebrows.
"And what is your relationship with him?" he asked.
"That’s none of your business."
Liu Yucang didn’t get upset at her refusal to answer and turned to Xu Jiaqi.
"What about her? Is she really your adoptive daughter?" he asked Yuan.
"Technically, I never formally adopted her as my daughter," Yuan admitted.
"Oh? So you’ve been lying this entire time?" Liu Yucang looked at Xu Jiaqi and chuckled provocatively.
Before Xu Jiaqi could even respond, Yuan continued, "With that being said, she was definitely like a daughter to me—to Tian Yingzhe."
"Yuan... You..." Xu Jiaqi’s eyes flickered with emotions.
Yuan turned to Xu Jiaqi with an apologetic smile.

"Sorry for keeping it a secret from you this entire time, but I have known about being Tian Yingzhe’s reincarnation long before our talk about Fateful Reincarnations. I had contemplated telling you back then, but I wasn’t sure how to reveal it to you, so it just kept on dragging."
After a moment of silence, Xu Jiaqi asked in a low voice, "How much do you remember?"
"Not everything, but I do remember all of our time together."
"I see... so you remember everything..."
Xu Jiaqi tried to stay calm and hold back her tears, but in the end she couldn’t, and a single tear slipped from the corner of her eye.
"There’s no need to hold yourself back."
Yuan suddenly approached her, arms spread.
The moment Xu Jiaqi saw the look on Yuan’s face, whatever restraint she had left completely shattered. She rushed into his embrace and buried her face against his chest, bawling her eyes out.

"You vanished without a word, leaving no trace behind! Even hundreds of thousands of years later, I never stopped searching for you! I spread my name throughout the Nine Heavens, hoping that one day it would reach you and bring you back to me! I’ve missed you so much!" she cried.
"I’m sorry for disappearing on you... on everyone without a word..." Yuan mumbled as he caressed the back of her head like Tian Yingzhe used to.

Qiang Qing Yun and Liu Yucang stared at them with their eyes wide open in disbelief. Not even in their wildest dreams had they imagined they would ever see Xu Jiaqi cry like this, much less utter such passionate words.
After crying for several long minutes, Xu Jiaqi eventually managed to calm down.
When she finally lifted her face from Yuan’s chest, her eyes and nose were still bright red, while the front of his robes was soaked with her tears and snot.
"Now then, let’s talk about the future of the faction," Yuan said, then turned to Liu Yucang.
"But before that... why are you trying to become the leader?"

"Honestly, I had no intention of doing so when I first joined the faction. I was never the leader type, after all. However..." Liu Yucang looked at Xu Jiaqi before continuing, "When I saw this woman claiming to be your daughter, I thought she was lying and using your name to her advantage. Not only that, but the faction had already split into two sides by the time I joined. When I saw the state it was in, I had no choice but to step forward and join the power struggle, hoping to win everything. I couldn’t bear to watch your legacy be tarnished."
